record.question: Who discovered South Pole?
record.explanation: Answer B: Amundsen. Roald Amundsen led the first expedition known to reach the geographic South Pole, on 14 December 1911. The original question's discovered should be understood as first reached, rather than discovery of Antarctica as a continent. Historical/source note: First known expedition to reach the geographic South Pole; the source uses the less precise word discovered. Reference: https://nettarkiv.npolar.no/www.nansenamundsen.no/en/galleries/amundsen/south-pole-1911/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
